name: LibreDB Studio
description: LibreDB Studio is a browser-based SQL IDE you run on your own server. It connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch and many more databases, with optional AI query help from a local Ollama model.

notes.text: The admin password is generated during install and written to /etc/libredb-studio/env inside the container.
The install sets AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=false because the container is reached over plain HTTP. Remove that line when you put the app behind HTTPS.
The AI panel is hidden unless a model is configured, and nothing leaves the container while it is unconfigured.
